profile.headline: Backend Engineer | System Design
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with expertise in Python, Django, React.js, and AWS. Skilled in modernizing legacy systems, automating workflows, and building scalable data solutions. Recent projects include migrating a PHP app to Python/React, developing Django APIs for estate planning, and optimizing data pipelines on AWS (RDS, EC2, S3, SQS).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Development & Data Management:

- Transitioned legacy PHP app to Python & React.js, enhancing usability.
- Developed Python automation tools for streamlined eligibility file processing.
- Created Django endpoints for an estate planning application.
- Engineered a Document Context Generation feature in Python/Django for legacy app integration.
- Developed InApp-tools in Django for sponsor management and enrollment data management.

Frontend Development & UI/UX:

- Crafted efficient data presentation and manipulation components in React.
- Developed a Plan Configuration page and a detailed file page, improving user experience.

Backend Development & Database Optimization:

- Devised comprehensive member data management solutions.
- Optimized backend functionalities by modifying Django factories.
- Created new serializers and views with filtering.
- Enhanced system performance through database transaction optimization.

Testing & Validation:

- Conducted robust system unit tests.
- Developed validation logic for enrollment file names.

Cloud Services & Data Transfer:

- Managed databases in Amazon RDS or EC2.
- Implemented SFTP uploads from the S3 bucket, improving data transfer processes.
- Built a Django command for continuous Amazon SQS queue message processing.

Automation & Efficiency Improvement:

- Created utility functions for data ingestion and feedback generation.
- Developed Python tools for efficient eligibility file processing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed overhaul of Lithic.tech marketing site.
Tools: GatsbyJS, GraphQL
Live: https://lithic.tech

Created User Interface Components for a financial technology application focused on better ways to pay rent, make large purchases, and build credit and buying power.
Tools:  React Native, Ruby, Rspec
Live: https://www.boompay.app

Helped maintain an online farmer’s market and fulfillment system that allows customers to shop their local community of farmers and producers. 
Tools: ReactJS for Frontend, Ruby for Backend, Rspec for Testing.
Live: https://www.localmilkrun.com

Engineered a replacement Vehicle Routing Problem solver. 
Tools: Ruby, Google Maps API, Mapbox 

Updated Dashboard Interface and Improved communications user experience for modern property management software focused on mid-size property managers.
Tools: ReactJS
Live: https://www.getrentroom.com

positions.title: Graphic Web Designer
positions.description:
Created the look and of the organization's online presence in social media by researching the target audience, establishing important metrics & designing engaging content.
Developed templates for e-newsletters, presentations and reports using Adobe Products.
Designed unique print materials, including flyers, brochures and logo designs in Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator. 
Designed current organization's logo for which I received the Certificate of Nomination Student Employee at PSU.
Created the Annual Report for the department. ( 2 Reports Completed / 25 pages each) using Adobe InDesign.

positions.title: Junior Developer Intern
positions.description:
Developed key components for the rebranded agency website using React.js.
Developed the 404 Page using assets designed in Sketch.
Actively participated in Scrum Meetings using Jira for issue tracking & Asana to communicate with the Project Managers.
Developed HTML/CSS email campaigns for clients like Nike, Providence, Oregon College Savings Plan, Dollar Shave Club, and Intel.

honors.issuer: Issued by Portland State University · Apr 2018
